name: Baddies & Blueballs
source:
You play as Asher, a cute dog boy new in the college area, looking for some place to rent nearby, where you meet Cherry and Zoey. They give you a great reception, but there's always something that gets in the way for you to really pop it, y'know?

[From [url=https://putzpinkie.itch.io/baddies-and-blueballs]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演亚瑟，一个刚来到大学区的可爱的狗男孩，在附近寻找出租的地方，在那里你遇到了樱桃和佐伊。他们给了你很好的接待，但总有一些事情会阻碍你真正流行起来，你知道吗？

[来自[url=https://putzpinkie.itch.io/baddies-and-blueballs]itch.io[/url]]
